claim.text: Research-period backtest: Sharpe 1.8, annual return 4%, maximum drawdown 4%.

charges.argument: The strategy's claimed performance is based on a research-period backtest without any validation on out-of-sample data. This makes the performance results potentially unreliable due to the knife-edge effect, where the strategy may not generalize well to new data.

verdict.opinion: The strategy's performance is based solely on a research-period backtest without out-of-sample validation, raising concerns about generalizability. Paper trading is recommended to assess real-world performance.
